name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
summary: Kravel Koalbeard, a dwarf at the Mirage Raceway, makes it his business to get people what they need. The gnomes there are waiting on parts that reached Ratchet a week ago, and Kravel cannot go himself. He sends you to Ratchet with his parts order for Wharfmaster Dizzywig.

sections.title: Legwork for Kravel
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard sees to it that people get the things they need. The gnomes of the Mirage Raceway are waiting on a batch of parts that reached Ratchet a week ago, and Kravel cannot make the journey himself. He asks you to do the legwork, and promises more jobs with serious profit potential if you do.

sections.title: The Docks of Ratchet
sections.body: Ratchet lies in the Barrens. Wharfmaster Dizzywig, a goblin, is the one to see, and Kravel says Dizzywig will probably be at the docks. You carry Kravel's Parts Order there.

faq.q: Who sends you to Wharfmaster Dizzywig?
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, a dwarf at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles, gives you his parts order and sends you to Ratchet.

faq.q: Where can Wharfmaster Dizzywig be found?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig is a goblin, and Kravel expects to find Dizzywig at the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Kravel's order?
faq.answer: The gnomes of the Mirage Raceway are waiting on parts that reached Ratchet a week ago. Kravel cannot go himself, so he asks you to carry his order to the docks there.
The next step in the chain is Parts for Kravel.
